categories.main_business_segments: The company's primary business is the research, development, production, and sales of precision bearing rolling bodies, including bearing steel balls and rollers. The company is a leading domestic manufacturer of precision bearing steel balls, producing steel balls with nominal diameters of 0.80mm-100.00mm (up to G3 precision grade) and rollers with diameters of 9.00mm-80.00mm (up to Grade I precision). These products are widely applied in automotive, precision machine tools, light industrial appliances, robotics, wind power generation, construction machinery, aerospace, and other general mechanical equipment manufacturing sectors.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company possesses internationally advanced core technologies and production processes for bearing steel ball manufacturing, including precision cold heading, continuous heat treatment, steel ball surface strengthening, and resin wheel precision grinding. For rollers, the company has developed precision conical roller four-position high-speed cold heading technology and equipment, high-precision conical roller grinding processes, and environmentally-friendly zero-decarburization heat treatment technology. The company operates advanced manufacturing and inspection equipment imported from Germany, Japan, Belgium, and Italy, with digital management of production processes and intelligent automation of production lines.
categories.primary_customers_markets: The company's primary customers are bearing manufacturers, including the global eight major bearing manufacturers (SKF, Schaeffler, NSK, NTN, JTEKT, TIMKEN, NMB, NACHI). The company is the only domestic state-owned enterprise that has entered the global procurement system of the international eight major bearing manufacturers. Key customers include GKN, SKF, ILJIN, and JTEKT. End markets include automotive (fuel vehicles and new energy vehicles), precision CNC machine tools, light industrial appliances, robotics, wind power generation, railway transportation, shield machine main shafts, and heavy-duty trucks.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates primarily in China, with its headquarters and main production facilities in Rugao, Jiangsu Province. The company has established subsidiaries including Nantong General Steel Ball Co., Ltd., Jiangsu Xingye Precision Roller Technology Co., Ltd., Listar Steel Ball (Nangyang) Co., Ltd., and Listar Golden Swallow Steel Ball (Ningbo) Co., Ltd. The company also has overseas operations through JGBR American Investing Corp in Delaware, USA, and Jiangsu Listar (Poland) Limited Liability Company. Products are exported to over 30 countries and regions including the United States, Germany, France, Italy, Mexico, Japan, and South Korea.
categories.supply_chain_position: The company operates in the midstream of the bearing manufacturing supply chain. It is positioned between upstream bearing steel producers (such as Baosteel and Daido Special Steel) and downstream bearing manufacturers (such as SKF, NSK, and domestic bearing companies). The company transforms raw bearing steel materials into precision rolling bodies that are then integrated into complete bearing assemblies by downstream manufacturers.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company's strategic focus includes: (1) advancing digital factory construction and operational efficiency; (2) expanding global industrial layout through investments in Mexico, the United States, and other regions; (3) developing high-precision ceramic balls as a new core product; (4) expanding heavy-load roller production capacity for wind power, rail transit, and shield machine applications; (5) developing high-speed railway bearing rollers (350km/h and above) and new energy vehicle steel balls; (6) implementing talent-driven and innovation-driven strategies with emphasis on R&D investment (5.40% of revenue in 2023) and human capital development.
categories.revenue_model: The company generates revenue primarily through direct sales of bearing steel balls and rollers to bearing manufacturers. The revenue model includes: (1) direct sales to major international bearing manufacturers (accounting for approximately 53.82% of revenue from top five customers); (2) consignment sales to domestic bearing manufacturers; (3) sales of other products including scrap materials and processing services. The company operates on a cost-plus pricing model based on material costs, processing precision, and customer-specific requirements, with credit terms typically ranging from 60 to 120 days depending on customer creditworthiness.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company's main competitors include Japan's Tsubaki Nakajima Company (specializing in steel balls and precision components), Shandong Dong'e Steel Ball Group (focusing on small-diameter steel balls below 25.40mm), Ningbo Haiyate Roller Co., Ltd. (producing conical rollers for automotive applications), and Dalian Weiyuan Bearing Co., Ltd. (producing large and extra-large rollers). The company ranks first domestically in bearing steel ball sales revenue and is the only domestic state-owned enterprise in the global procurement system of the international eight major bearing manufacturers, positioning it as the industry leader in China with significant competitive advantages in technology, product quality, and customer relationships.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: The company is a mid-sized manufacturer with 2023 operating revenue of approximately 1.001 billion yuan, representing 2.12% growth compared to 2022 (980.85 million yuan). Net profit attributable to shareholders was 59.88 million yuan in 2023, down 3.95% from 62.34 million yuan in 2022. Total assets reached 1.825 billion yuan at year-end 2023, with shareholders' equity of 1.233 billion yuan. The company has demonstrated steady growth over the three-year period from 2021-2023, with revenue growing from 973.9 million yuan in 2021 to 1.001 billion yuan in 2023, though profitability has shown some fluctuation.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company's competitive differentiation is built on: (1) advanced precision manufacturing capabilities with products meeting international standards and some performance indicators exceeding international benchmarks; (2) comprehensive quality management systems including IATF16949:2016 certification and recognition as a National Enterprise Technology Center; (3) long-term stable relationships with global eight major bearing manufacturers, providing access to premium customer segments; (4) continuous innovation in product development, including high-precision ceramic balls, high-speed railway bearing rollers, and specialized rollers for wind power and shield machines; (5) strong brand recognition with the 'Listar' trademark recognized as a China Famous Trademark; (6) comprehensive product portfolio covering full-size specifications and multiple precision grades to meet diverse customer requirements.
